description: Paper 3 design 4 (spec §6 'Investment optimization', ~2,000 runs): the four spec §4 surveillance investment tiers (Baseline / Minimal / Moderate / Full) crossed with hull, voyage length and founder count, for the cost-benefit frontier that picard_framework/analysis/economics consumes. Absolute dollar levels stay provisional: the valuation rates are placeholders and the dose is unpinned until the C1 hourly refit. Hourly clock, drawn-incubation arm.

surveillance_tier_notes.inv_baseline: Spec §4 Baseline: syndromic sick-call only, no sequencing.
surveillance_tier_notes.inv_minimal: Spec §4 Minimal: clinical qPCR/amplicon typing via the cascade.
surveillance_tier_notes.inv_moderate: Spec §4 Moderate: cascade + Nanopore verification + amplicon wastewater with lineage deconvolution.
surveillance_tier_notes.inv_full: Spec §4 Full: Moderate plus surface sampling and a deeper, long-read wastewater library.
